correctness.rationale: For each list limit one through six, exact finite codebooks attain the six claimed cardinalities; rational nonnegative shadow weights and slack vectors satisfy all 128 dual inequalities, giving upper objectives strictly less than the next integers. RESULT.md gives six exact values and rational certificates
value.rationale: A fixed small-list tradeoff is an explicit research question in the recent primary literature. Six consecutive exact capacities at one nontrivial blocklength provide a complete nonasymptotic benchmark for that parameter slice, not a routine single numeric increment; the affine middle regime and endpoint deviations are structural observations. The 32 received words and 128 codewords form the full natural finite instance, and the exact codebooks and dual certificates offer reusable tests for proposed coding bounds. No downstream general theorem is asserted.
risks: This finite classification does not establish a general-length law; value rests on exact benchmarking of the stated natural instance.
